charts.title: TOI-908 b: orbits around TOI-908
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-908's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-908 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hawthorn et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.524.3877H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HAWTHORN_ET_AL_2023): P 3.183792 d

charts.title: TOI-908 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-908 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (93, 94, 95) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 350153977, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 16 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 17 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 16 min early; 10-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
